name: What is the process for getting a professional home value estimate?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for getting a professional home value estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process for a professional home value estimate typically begins with an initial consultation to discuss your property and goals. A real estate agent will then conduct a thorough property visit to assess its condition, features, and any upgrades. They will then perform a comparative market analysis (CMA) by evaluating recent sales of similar properties in your specific area, such as Key Biscayne or Pinecrest. Finally, they will provide a detailed report outlining their estimated value and market insights.
acceptedAnswer.description: A professional home value estimate involves a consultation, property visit, comparative market analysis by an agent, and a detailed report of findings.
